label: calendar
title: Google Calendar tool
description: A Sovereign Website tool for your calendar, in your browser with your own Google sign-in, read-only first, demo on synthetic events. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.
conditions: As the Gmail tool (cd9266f): Sovereign Website brand, no look-alike, no Google logo or trade dress, a notice that it is not affiliated with Google. OAuth with restricted Calendar scopes, read-only first; the token in memory, or sessionStorage on opt-in, never localStorage. A CSP limited to self and the Google API hosts it uses. An ABP. A security review before real use.
